name: Chia seeds
description: Gel-forming little seeds (often confused with desi sabja — see basil seeds).

ayurveda.note: Used like cooling sabja in modern practice; not classical.

unani.note: Treated like tukh malanga in modern desi use.

nutrition.highlight: they gel in water, which is the whole trick

effects.note: Small randomised trials find chia seeds stirred into a meal — yogurt in one, baked into cookies in another — can modestly raise satiety and cut short-term food intake through the soluble fibre's gel-forming bulk, but results are inconsistent: the cookie trial found little to no effect on subjective appetite despite a real change in post-meal blood sugar. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
